newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen yuan deposits hit 154.5 billion yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen yuan deposits hit 154.5 billion yuan.

text.p: Chinese yuan deposits in domestic financial institutions in China's boomtown of Shenzhen were up 28 percent year-on-year to 154.5 billion yuan at the end of 1996, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said loans on the books of the institutions, including banks and trust and investment companies, also increased 22 percent to 96.7 billion yuan.
Foreign exchange deposits in domestic financial units reached US$6.5 billion at end-1996, up US$1.06 billion over the previous year, while loans rose US$780 million to US$6.4 billion.
Deposits in overseas financial institutions in the city jumped US$90 million year-on-year to US$750 million by end-1996, while loans climbed US$700 million to US$3.7 billion, the newspaper said.
